# ADR Template

Copy to `docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md` using the next free number.
Check the bar in [`../decisions/README.md`](../decisions/README.md) first — most changes do
not need an ADR.

---

```markdown
# ADR-NNNN — <Short decision title>

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-NNNN | Deprecated
**Deciders:** <who>

## Context
The situation that forced a decision. What is true about the environment, verified how.

## Problem
The specific question being decided, in one or two sentences.

## Options considered
### Option A — <name>
Pros / cons.
### Option B — <name>
Pros / cons.
### Option C — <name>
Pros / cons.

## Decision
What was chosen. State it plainly.

## Reason
Why this option beat the others. Reference evidence — a probe, a measurement, a
constraint — not preference.

## Consequences
**Positive** — what this buys.
**Negative** — what this costs, honestly.
**Follow-up required** — work this creates.

## Revisit when
The concrete condition that would justify reopening this decision.
```
